$$

$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left[ \frac {r ^ {2}}{R (r)} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} R (r)}{\mathrm {d} r ^ {2}} + \frac {r}{R (r)} \frac {\mathrm {d} R (r)}{\mathrm {d} r} \right] - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {1}{\Theta (\theta)} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} \Theta (\theta)}{\mathrm {d} \theta^ {2}} + r ^ {2} V (r) = r ^ {2} E, \\ - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left[ \frac {r ^ {2}}{R (r)} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} R (r)}{\mathrm {d} r ^ {2}} + \frac {r}{R (r)} \frac {\mathrm {d} R (r)}{\mathrm {d} r} \right] + r ^ {2} V (r) - r ^ {2} E = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {1}{\Theta (\theta)} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} \Theta (\theta)}{\mathrm {d} \theta^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
